content.title: Need an LOR?
content.subtitle: A good LOR comes from good planning.

steps.title: Pick the right person
steps.detail: Someone who knows you well matters more than a big name.

steps.title: Ask early
steps.detail: Request well before the deadline. They have other work too.

steps.title: Send a brief
steps.detail: Your resume, the course name and the projects you did with them. It makes recalling easy.

steps.title: Explain the process
steps.detail: Tell them in advance when the portal link will come and what to fill.

steps.title: Say thank you
steps.detail: Thank them after they submit. Share your result with them when it comes.

content.saveLine: useful when you need an LOR.

caption:
Asking a professor or manager for an LOR feels awkward? Follow these 5 steps 👇

1. Pick the right person
2. Ask early
3. Send a brief
4. Explain the process
5. Say thank you

Save it 📌 and send it to a friend who needs it.
